queries.text:
with recursive p as (
    select u.id, u.subject, u.kind, u.name, u.lang,
           case when bool_or(g.admin) then enum_range(null::fn)
                else coalesce(array_agg(distinct gf.fn) filter (where gf.fn is not null), '{}') end as functions
    from "user" u
    left join user_group_member m on m.user_id = u.id
    left join user_group g on g.id = m.user_group_id
    left join user_group_fn gf on gf.user_group_id = g.id
    where u.subject = any($1::text[]) and not u.archived
    group by u.id
), tree as (
    select p.id as root_id, u.id from p join "user" u on u.manager_id = p.id
    where 'scope_tree' = any(p.functions)
    union
    select t.root_id, u.id from tree t join "user" u on u.manager_id = t.id
)
select p.subject, p.id, p.kind, p.name, p.lang, p.functions,
       jsonb_build_object('team', to_jsonb(t.ids), 'user', to_jsonb(p.id || t.ids)) as reach
from p
cross join lateral (
    select coalesce(array_agg(u.id order by u.id), '{}') as ids
    from "user" u
    where u.id <> p.id
      and ('scope_all' = any(p.functions) and u.kind = 'human'
           or 'scope_direct' = any(p.functions) and u.manager_id = p.id
           or u.id in (select tree.id from tree where tree.root_id = p.id))
) t
queries.name: Principal
comments: Principals of the given identity-provider subjects: subject, id, kind, name, language, functions
(union of their groups; an admin group grants all) and named reaches (self is the kernel's):
team = direct reports (scope_direct), the whole subtree (scope_tree) or every other human (scope_all),
user = self and team. Archived principals are absent.

from activity_p a
left join project p on p.id = a.project_id
left join folder f on f.id = a.folder_id
left join task t on t.id = a.task_id

from generate_series($2::date, $3::date, interval '1 day') g
cross join lateral (select g::date as date) d
cross join lateral work_due($1::bigint, d.date, d.date) w
left join (

    from activity_p a

queries.text:
select u.id as user_id, k.carried_min, k.due_min, k.done_min, k.carried_min + k.done_min - k.due_min as balance_min,
       k.vac_carried_min, k.vac_available_min, k.vac_taken_min, k.vac_carried_min + k.vac_available_min - k.vac_taken_min as vac_balance_min
from "user" u
left join work_start s on s.user_id = u.id
left join (
    select x.user_id,
           sum(x.counted_min) filter (where x.date < cast($1 as date) and x.date >= ws.first_day) as done_before,
           sum(x.counted_min) filter (where x.date >= cast($1 as date)) as done,
           sum(x.duration_min) filter (where x.kind = 'vacation' and x.date < cast($1 as date) and x.date >= ws.first_day) as vac_before,
           sum(x.duration_min) filter (where x.kind = 'vacation' and x.date >= cast($1 as date)) as vac_taken
    from activity_p x
    left join work_start ws on ws.user_id = x.user_id
    where x.date <= least(cast($2 as date), sor_today()) and x.user_id = any($3::bigint[])
    group by x.user_id
) d on d.user_id = u.id
cross join lateral work_due(u.id, s.first_day, cast($1 as date) - 1) w0
cross join lateral work_due(u.id, cast($1 as date), least(cast($2 as date), sor_today())) w1
cross join lateral (
    select round(coalesce(d.done_before, 0) - w0.due_min)::integer as carried_min,
           round(w1.due_min)::integer as due_min,
           coalesce(d.done, 0)::integer as done_min,
           round(w0.vacation_min - coalesce(d.vac_before, 0))::integer as vac_carried_min,
           round(w1.vacation_min)::integer as vac_available_min,
           coalesce(d.vac_taken, 0)::integer as vac_taken_min
) k
where u.kind = 'human' and u.id = any($3::bigint[])
order by u.name

select f.project_id, r.folder_id, r.duration_min, r.billed_min, r.services_amount, r.expenses_billed, r.expenses_user, r.realized_amount, r.invoiced_amount, r.balance_amount
from (
    select r.folder_id,
           sum(r.duration_min)::integer as duration_min, sum(r.billed_min)::integer as billed_min,
           sum(r.services_amount) as services_amount, sum(r.expenses_billed) as expenses_billed, sum(r.expenses_user) as expenses_user,
           sum(r.realized_amount) as realized_amount, sum(r.invoiced_amount) as invoiced_amount, sum(r.balance_amount) as balance_amount
    from activity_revenue r
    where r.date between $1 and $2
    group by r.folder_id
) r
join folder f on f.id = r.folder_id
queries.name: Profitability
comments: Per folder and its project, over the activities of a period: durations, services, expenses billed and reimbursed,
realized (services and expenses billed), invoiced, balance (realized minus invoiced). Invoiced activities use their frozen values.
@anchor none
@needs invoice

queries.text:
select f.project_id, r.folder_id, r.duration_min, r.billed_min, r.counted_min, r.services_amount, r.expenses_billed, r.expenses_user, r.realized_amount, r.invoiced_amount, r.balance_amount, r.cost_amount, r.margin_services, r.margin_balance
from (
    select r.folder_id,
           sum(r.duration_min)::integer as duration_min, sum(r.billed_min)::integer as billed_min, sum(r.counted_min)::integer as counted_min,
           sum(r.services_amount) as services_amount, sum(r.expenses_billed) as expenses_billed, sum(r.expenses_user) as expenses_user,
           sum(r.realized_amount) as realized_amount, sum(r.invoiced_amount) as invoiced_amount, sum(r.balance_amount) as balance_amount,
           sum(r.cost_amount) as cost_amount, sum(r.margin_services) as margin_services, sum(r.margin_balance) as margin_balance
    from activity_cost r
    where r.date between $1 and $2
    group by r.folder_id
) r
join folder f on f.id = r.folder_id
queries.name: ProfitabilityCost
comments: Profitability with the cost (counted minutes times hourly cost) and the margins on services and on balance.
@anchor none
@needs cost

queries.text:
select a.id from activity a
where a.id in (select l.activity_id from invoice_line l where l.invoice_id = any($1::bigint[]))
order by a.id
for update
queries.name: InvoiceLockActivities
comments: Locks the activities of invoices, by id, before they are attached or released.

queries.text:
update activity a set invoice_id = l.invoice_id
from invoice_line l
where l.activity_id = a.id and l.invoice_id = any($1::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceAttachActivities
comments: Attaches its candidate activities to each draft invoice.

queries.text:
update activity a set (frozen_rate, frozen_billed_min, frozen_amount) =
    (select p.rate, p.billed_min, p.amount from activity_p p where p.id = a.id)
where a.invoice_id = any($1::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceFreezeActivities
comments: Freezes rate, billed duration and amount of the activities attached to invoices, read in their projection.

queries.text:
update expense e set (frozen_user_amount, frozen_billed_amount) =
    (select x.user_amount, x.billed_amount from expense_p x where x.id = e.id)
where e.activity_id in (select a.id from activity a where a.invoice_id = any($1::bigint[]))
queries.name: InvoiceFreezeExpenses
comments: Freezes the amounts of the expenses of the activities attached to invoices, read in their projection.

queries.text: update invoice set invoiced_at = sor_now(), invoiced_by = $1 where id = any($2::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceMarkInvoiced
comments: Marks invoices invoiced by the principal, now.

queries.text:
update expense set frozen_user_amount = null, frozen_billed_amount = null
where activity_id in (select a.id from activity a where a.invoice_id = any($1::bigint[]))
queries.name: InvoiceReleaseExpenses
comments: Clears the frozen amounts of the expenses of the activities of invoices.

queries.text:
update activity set invoice_id = null, frozen_rate = null, frozen_billed_min = null, frozen_amount = null
where invoice_id = any($1::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceReleaseActivities
comments: Detaches the activities of invoices and clears their frozen values.

queries.text: update invoice set invoiced_at = null, invoiced_by = null where id = any($1::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceBackToDraft
comments: Returns invoices to draft.

queries.text: update invoice set pdf_file_id = $1 where id = any($2::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceAttachPdf
comments: Attaches the rendered PDF to invoices.

queries.text:
select s.delivery_id as id, s.root_table, s.root_id, s.created_at, s.state, s.attempts, s.last_at, s.last_status, s.last_detail
from delivery_state s
where s.connection_id = $1
order by s.delivery_id desc
queries.name: ConnectionDelivery
comments: Deliveries to a connection, newest first, with their state.
@anchor none
@needs master_data

queries.text:
select s.delivery_id as id, s.connection_id, s.created_at, s.state, s.attempts, s.last_at, s.last_status, s.last_detail
from delivery_state s
where s.root_table = 'invoice' and s.root_id = $1
order by s.delivery_id desc
queries.name: AccountingExport
comments: Exports of an invoice to the accounting system: state, attempts and last detail.
@anchor none
@needs invoice

queries.text:
insert into delivery (connection_id, kind, root_table, root_id, payload, principal_id)
select c.id, 'invoice', 'invoice', d.invoice_id, d.document, $1
from invoice_document d
join connection c on c.kind = 'accounting'
where d.invoice_id = any($2::bigint[])
queries.name: InvoiceExport
comments: Writes the delivery of each invoice document to the accounting connection.

queries.text:
update connection set cursor = coalesce($1::text, cursor), pulled_at = sor_now(), pull_error = $2::text
where id = any($3::bigint[])
queries.name: ConnectionAdvance
comments: Records a pull of connections: its cursor (kept when empty), the instant and the error if any.

queries.text:
insert into account (external_id, name, address) values ($1, $2, $3)
on conflict (external_id) do update set name = excluded.name, address = excluded.address
queries.name: AccountUpsertFromAccounting
comments: Creates or updates a client from the accounting system, by its external id.

queries.text:
insert into project (external_id, account_id, name)
select $1, a.id, $2 from account a where a.external_id = $3
on conflict (external_id) do update set name = excluded.name, account_id = excluded.account_id
queries.name: ProjectUpsertFromAccounting
comments: Creates or updates a project from the accounting system, by its external id and the external id of its client.
